capabilities: manage multiple color slots in the status bar
switch between color slots via hotkeys
extras: The README states the plugin entered maintenance mode in October 2025: it stays functional but only critical bug reports and pull requests will be reviewed. Known bugs remain, including coloring headings and bullet points (bullet bug fixed), no MathJax/LaTeX support, and incomplete mobile support.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to give selected text arbitrary colors beyond manual HTML or highlighting.
summary: Text-coloring plugin that applies colors to selected text using swappable color slots, hotkeys, context-menu commands, and a highlight mode.
